description: Stable paragraph-level chunks for one book, each with a permanent chunk_id (lang:slug:chapter:para), citation text and canonical URL. When to use: you need RAG-ready passages with deterministic IDs instead of whole chapters, or you want to cache/index exact passages. Do not use: to read a whole chapter (cyberlibrary_get_chapter) or to search across books (cyberlibrary_verify_quote / cyberlibrary_fulltext_search). Returns: {lang, slug, title, license, corpus_version, total_chunks, chunks[{chunk_id, chapter, para, text, citation, url}]}.

chapter.description: Optional chapter number; omit for the whole book.

name: cyberlibrary_get_chunks
